  • Method Details

    • addTraining

      void addTraining(String name, String description, int duration, boolean isInPerson, float price) throws SQLException, ClassNotFoundException, IllegalArgumentException
      Check all variables if not null and valid to create a training course in training table.
      Parameters:
      name - Training course name.
      description - Training course description.
      duration - Training course duration in day.
      isInPerson - True if training course is on-site, else false is remote.
      price - Training course price.
      Throws:
      SQLException - Error SQL Request or Timeout connection.
      ClassNotFoundException - The Driver Class isn't found.
      IllegalArgumentException - Error if name or description is null or empty or duration is inferior to 1 or price is inferior to 0.

    • displayListByKeyWord

      List<fr.app.entities.Training> displayListByKeyWord(String keyWord) throws SQLException, ClassNotFoundException
      Send a SQL request with the keyWord in the criteria.
      Parameters:
      keyWord - Word to filter in SQL Request on name and description columns.
      Returns:
      Training list with keyWord filter or all list if keyWord is empty.
      Throws:
      SQLException - Error SQL Request or Timeout connection.
      ClassNotFoundException - The Driver Class isn't found.

    • filterKeywordAndOnSiteOrRemote

      List<fr.app.entities.Training> filterKeywordAndOnSiteOrRemote(String keyWord, boolean onSite) throws SQLException, ClassNotFoundException
      Send a SQL request with the keyWord and if on-site or remote in the criteria.
      Parameters:
      keyWord - Word to filter in SQL Request on name and description columns.
      onSite - true if filter on-site, false if filter remote.
      Returns:
      Training list with keyWord filter or all list if keyWord is empty.
      Throws:
      SQLException - Error SQL Request or Timeout connection.
      ClassNotFoundException - The Driver Class isn't found.
